svg.aria-label: Magnet Timer: I built the world's first timer that runs on a cube's own magnets. The phone's magnetometer senses the lift and starts the clock, and the accelerometer catches the drop and stops it. It needs no extra hardware. Start to store: I design the screens, write the code, and publish the apps to the App Store and Google Play myself. Phones as hardware: I turn a phone's accelerometer, magnetometer and camera into gear people would otherwise have to buy. Competition software: I write what Zeka Küpü Türkiye runs its competitions on: registration, scoring, live results, printed documents. Films and visuals: I also make the product films, store pages and graphics. CAD and data: Away from code I draw in AutoCAD, SolidWorks and Fusion 360, and work with data in Python, SQL and Power BI. How I work: I start from the architecture, check the data, and go after the root cause. Technical debt bothers me. Reverse engineering: I take iOS and Android apps apart with IDA, Ghidra, Frida and jadx, and write Theos tweaks in Objective-C.
